title: Congress.gov Notifications Register Now to Attend the Congressional Data Task Force Meeting on Thursday, June 11, 2026
summary:
The Congressional Data Task Force will have their next public meeting on Thursday, June 11, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM EDT. This is a hybrid event hosted in the Library of Congress, Thomas Jefferson Building, Room LJ-119 (first floor), and online via the Webex platform. Listen to updates from various legislative branch partners. There will also be updates on recent Congress.gov enhancements.

 

Register at: Congressional Data Task Force | Legislative Branch Innovation Hub
